propositions: Phase 3 remediation proposals lack validation against recorded project decisions and evidence of reachable harm, allowing unflagged proposals to reach Phase 4 approval
The five-phase janitor pipeline's Verification phase scores finding validity but does not validate remedy proposals; blind proposer agreement measures prompt stability rather than correctness
Phase 2 must add harm_reachable as a fifth validity sub-question and prior_decision checks to surface deliberate recorded choices and demand evidence of changed circumstances before reversing them
Phase 3 must replace the OSS-research tiebreak with asymmetric proposers asking different questions and a targeted divergence research round when moves do not converge
Phase 4 must surface prior_decision records and flag HARDENING findings at review time so users see the full evidence context for any remedy that reverses recorded intent
